# strided-rs v0.8.0

`strided-exec` is replaced by [`threadteam` 0.1](https://github.com/tensor4all/threadteam-rs),
the same crate (same API, history preserved) moved to its own repository so the other
tensor4all CPU crates can share one placement implementation. `strided-exec` is no longer
part of this workspace and gets no further releases.

Released at 0.8.0: `strided-perm`, `strided-basic`, `strided-fused`, `strided-kernel`,
`strided-nn`. `strided-traits` and `strided-view` stay at 0.7.0 (they never depended on
`strided-exec`).

**Migration.** Replace `strided_exec::` with `threadteam::` (`Exec`, `Pool`,
`PoolBuilder` and everything else keep their names and signatures), or use the
re-exports of `strided-basic` (`strided_basic::{Exec, Pool, PoolBuilder}`). In
`Cargo.toml`, replace `strided-exec` with:

```toml
threadteam = "0.1.0"
```

with the same features (`parallel`, and `ledger` for tests).

The `parallel` features of `strided-perm`, `strided-basic`, `strided-fused` and
`strided-kernel` forward to `threadteam/parallel` as they did to `strided-exec/parallel`.

## Parallel regions decided by cost; `MINTHREADLENGTH` removed

Every parallel decision is now `exec.pays(estimate, sections, width)` or
`exec.width_for(estimate, sections)` against the token's dispatch cost, with
`estimate = elements * serial time per element of the kernel's class`
(`strided_basic::execution::KernelClass`: copy, map, transcendental, reduce; the rates are
keyed by host class). Requires `threadteam` 0.1.

Breaking changes (`strided-basic`, `strided-perm`):

- `strided_perm::MINTHREADLENGTH` and `strided_basic::execution::MINTHREADLENGTH` are
  removed; `strided_perm::{HostClass, copy_ns_per_element, copy_ns_per_element_of}` are added.
- `execution::parallel_threads_for_len` is removed; `execution::{KernelClass, parallel_width,
  tree_width}` are added.
- `execution::mapreduce_threaded` takes a `class: KernelClass` argument before `exec`.
- Softmax (`strided-nn`) sizes its fan-out by the token's width instead of a bytes-per-task floor.
- Reductions that fan out are repeatable for a fixed layout, budget and kind of token.
